2  JUDGMENT The prayer in the writ petition is to renew Ext.P1 licence to run a meat stall dated 22.8.2023. 
2. A counter affidavit has been filed on behalf of the Panchayat, wherein, it is stated as follows:
"5. It is respectfully submitted that the petitioner herein was the successful bidder of the meat stall for the year 2018-19, 2021-22, 2023-24. The petitioner auctioned the selling right of the meat stall from Panchayat for the year 2023-24. The licence of the petitioner to conduct the meat stall for the year 2024-25 was expired but he is continuing the functioning of the meat stall on the basis of the interim order passed by this Hon'ble Court on 27.03.2024. The petitioner is conducting the meat stall in front of the stall of Mr. Luca Joseph who is the petitioner in WPC No.
16420/2024,who is the successful bidder for the year 2024-2025."
3. In view of the above statement that the petitioner has not even WP(C)Nos.12625/2024 &
16420/2024 4 2024:KER:67882 participated in the auction for the current year, no relief can be granted in the writ petition. Accordingly, the interim order granted on 22.3.2024 is vacated. It is made clear that the petitioner cannot conduct the meat shop as he does not have a valid licence. 
The writ petition is accordingly dismissed. In view of the dismissal of WP(C)No.12625/2024,
nothing further remains to be considered in this writ petition. Accordingly, the same is closed. 
Sd/- MOHAMMED NIAS C.P.
